basic_info.description: Discover this cheerful blend of modern updates & SF charm. Fresh & bright SFH features a family-friendly floor plan. Delightful architectural details combined w/ the comfort & convenience of contemporary living. Stylish renovated Kitchen w/ SS appliances & quartzite countertops make cooking in this light bright space a joy. Expansive Living & Dining areas are flooded w/ light & charming Deco details. A cozy fireplace & library shelves enhance the joyful living space, perfect for entertaining & daily gatherings. Fully updated Bath w/ generous storage, gleaming bathtub, shower, & clean spa-like design. 2 spacious BR welcome beaming morning sun & offer ample closet space. Downstairs 3rd BR w/ en suite Bath & walk-in closet easily doubles as a media room or guest quarters. Enjoy quiet office space w/ library & reading nook overlooking the garden. Direct yard access leads to a generous deck & verdant oasis where relaxation & fun await. Enjoy sparkling vistas while sipping your favorite evening refresher. Added highlights include freshly refinished hardwood floors, new light fixtures, & stylish finishes throughout. Attached Garage, Laundry area, & generous Storage. Easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, FWY, BART, & more. Experience the best of SF living in this exceptional home!
